summary: Android USB/BLE proxies: when the Python engine failed and closed its socket, late radio bytes made socket.add ('StreamSink is closed') or the awaited close in finally ('Broken pipe') replace the engine's error. RT-950 uses no flow control (XON_XOFF False), so not a flow-control gap. Likely masked error: owner selected the RT-950 profile for an RT-950 Pro, which the driver refuses as a different model.
